info.name: Story Builder API
info.description:
Complete API collection for the Story Builder DAG-based plot editor.

Base URL: `{{base_url}}`

Variables are auto-set via test scripts on create endpoints. Run in logical order (Stories → Graph → Characters → etc).

## Workflow
1. Create a Story → `story_id` set
2. Generate an outline via LLM → more nodes added
3. Create characters, locations, nodes, edges
4. Generate prose for nodes
5. Accept generations
